title: Documented container bind-mount path is unreachable from the code
description:
SPEC-HIRE.md:729 and DESIGN.md:729 both say containers should 'Bind-mount host socket to /run/hire/workload.sock'.

hire_grpc::socket::workload_socket_path() has no override of any kind (no SPIFFE_ENDPOINT_SOCKET, no PERSONA_SOCKET; grep finds neither in the tree), so the CLI and native messaging host inside a container resolve $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/hire/workload.sock or /tmp/hire-{uid}/workload.sock and never look at the mount point.

Either the row is aspirational and should say so, or the helper needs an override. If an override is added it should be SPIFFE_ENDPOINT_SOCKET, the name the SPIFFE Workload API spec already defines, rather than a persona-specific variable.

Deliberately not added during persona-5s4b.110: nobody asked for it, and inventing configuration was out of scope.
